svg.title: Shadow Jog roadmap
svg.desc: Order and dependency only. Bar length is not time. Now: M0 Prepare. Next: M1 Shell. Items in the same column can run in parallel. Foundations: Phase 0 Platform spike (done), Pre-M0 640x360 move (done), M0 Prepare (active). Engine path: M1 Shell (next), M2 Effects (later), M3 Battle stage (later), M5 Field (later), M6 Flip default (later), M7 3D mode (later), M8 Remove legacy (later). Side paths: M1b 3D proof (later), M4 UI scenes (optional). Needs Mark's go-ahead: archive-tags Archive tags (gated), release-tags Release tags (gated), deploy Deploy site (gated). Other open items (no order): playthrough-notes Playthrough notes edit (next), pixellab-end PixelLab end date (next), sprite-fusion Sprite credits (optional), cc-followups CC follow-ups (optional), plasma-bug plasma-ui bug report (optional).
svg.text: Now: M0 Prepare. Next: M1 Shell.
Order and dependency only. Bar length is not time.
READ LEFT TO RIGHT. A COLUMN IS A STEP IN THE ORDER. ITEMS IN ONE COLUMN CAN RUN IN PARALLEL. DATA UPDATED 2026-10-09.

g.title: Phase 0 Platform spike: done. Mark approved the final engine design on 2026-10-05. Record: docs/spikes/engine-platform.md.
Pre-M0 640x360 move: done. The shipped game plays at 640x360. Record: docs/PIVOT-640.md.
M0 Prepare: active. Size module, bundle gate, canary suite, agent docs. Worktree: projects/shadow-jog-engine.
M1 Shell: next. Loop, renderer, scene stack, LegacyScene adapter. Behind the ?engine=sje flag.
M2 Effects: later. FxSystem with the postfx facade, composite filter, particles.
M3 Battle stage: later. The side-battle rebuild lands here. Spike PRs #3 (side-battle) and #4 (phaser-stage) stay open as references and never merge.
M5 Field: later. Field map, actors, camera, lights, weather. Mark approves the lighting.
M6 Flip default: later. ?engine=sje becomes the default. The old presenter goes. M4 joins here if it is built. It is optional (dashed arrow).
M7 3D mode: later. Needs both the 3D proof (M1b) and the default flip (M6).
M8 Remove legacy: later. Delete the old engine files.
M1b 3D proof: later. Parallel with M2. A spinning cube in a Scene3D, with the hand-off, leak and loss tests.
M4 UI scenes: optional. Optional. A UI scene ports only when it needs a camera, a filter, a mask or a transition.

archive-tags Archive tags: gated. archive/side-battle-<date> and archive/phaser-stage-<date>, then close PRs #3 and #4. Mark approves each tag. They wait until M3 lands (status.md, Next for agents 3).
release-tags Release tags: gated. Annotated v* tags. Cut only after Mark's playtest and go-ahead. Not tied to one milestone. The column is only a place on the chart.

deploy Deploy site: gated. Site: shadowjog.com. The last alpha step, with the secure email sign-up. Only with Mark's explicit go-ahead. Not tied to one milestone. The column is only a place on the chart.
playthrough-notes Playthrough notes edit: next. Mark's uncommitted edit to docs/mark-playthrough-notes.md waits for him.
pixellab-end PixelLab end date: next. Decision 5 in docs/PHASE-0.2.md is open. The PixelLab plan ends about 2026-10-30.
sprite-fusion Sprite credits: optional. Sprite Fusion. Mark spends the next credits on the shopping list when he is ready.
cc-followups CC follow-ups: optional. Command Center items left over (status.md, Next for agents 1b). All optional.
plasma-bug plasma-ui bug report: optional. An upstream bug report for the plasma-ui canvas width (R28), if Mark wants one.

svg.text: NEXT Starts next, or waits for Mark
